doc: GRT smoke tier (results/grt.md, scripts/validate-increment.sh): which validation targets a changed path can reach. Every rule whose paths match a changed file adds its reach (an 'exclusive' rule that matches first ends the search: a .md anywhere reaches nothing); a changed file that NO rule matches reaches every target ('*'): conservative by default. Targets: pure (the pure self-tests, always run), lock-tests, capture-build, pnpm-test, cargo:<crate dir>, native:<gate>@<core>, g7:<group>@<receiver>, g7live:<group>@<receiver>, g7x:<group> (desktop g7-dev/g7-bench), none. '*' in a target pattern ranges over the universe below. Sabotage legs (native runs) run only when a changed path matches sabotage_paths or a changed file's content matches sabotage_content; otherwise they are skipped-by-tier (RS_SABOTAGE_TIER=skip). --milestone runs every target with sabotage.

smoke.doc: Smoke tier: the legs one representative run keeps, per group. g7live: RS_SMOKE_LEGS entries (leg directories relative to the native runner's --out; an entry also covers the directories under it), with the capture and reference legs the live leg is judged against; full_legs is the group's leg count in a full run (null: not counted). g7 (file mode): GATE7_SMOKE_LEGS, '@first' = the first non-sabotage receiver leg of each gate. A group not listed (g7-lc, g7-r, g7x, the native gates) runs whole in smoke; native gates still skip their sabotage legs unless the diff touches a checker. A change reaching collapse_at or more groups on a receiver is shared code: smoke runs the first reached group there and lists the rest in smoke_deferred (the full tier runs them). The verdict requires every named entry to have run, so a wrong name fails loudly.
smoke.defer_doc: Groups smoke never runs (the full tier and --milestone run them whole, listed in smoke_deferred): g7-k's soak legs hold the exclusive quiet lock for 300 s each (about 11 min per browser with startup), and run-gate7.sh has no leg filter for them that tier-verdict.py would accept. Run a g7-k change with --tier full --only g7live-<r>-timing.

timing_doc: GRT4a: targets whose runs go in validate-increment.sh's last phase, after every correctness run: their exclusive quiet-lock legs (gate 6's g6l/g6s/g6c/g6p, the timing live groups, the bench and device-control arms) starved the browser groups sharing a tier with them (G7q: 11.9-13.8 ks of summed lock wait). A receiver's live groups split into a correctness run and a -timing run.
local_cost_doc: Idle-machine wall seconds per local timing-phase run id, for validate-increment.sh's cost block (printed before the [timing] phase). Starting values are CAR1's idle-equivalent (wall minus quiet-lock wait, 2026-11-04). An id not listed prints 'unknown': measure it from a validate-summary.json (wall_s - lock_wait_s) and add it, never guess.

remote.doc: scripts/remote-validate.sh (docs/remote-compute.md): which planned runs may go to hosted runners at the current rung. A run is remote-capable when its id matches a 'capable' glob and nothing in 'refuse' applies; 'refuse' always wins. 'refuse.groups' refuses single groups of a gate 7 run (the run keeps its other groups remotely, and is refused whole when none is left). Every other run is refused with default_reason (each rung widens 'capable'). Refused runs are listed in the summary's remote.refused[] and may be run locally with --and-local.
remote.capable_doc: G8g: gate 8's browser group g7-8 (its file legs in g7-gsw/g7-web-rust and its live g8l legs in g7live-gsw/g7live-web-rust) is remote-capable: --determinism 2,1 (run 40088061009) agreed over 12 runs, 205/205 shots and 70/70 dumps. R4: bench-instr (cachegrind Ir per golden case; load-insensitive, so not a timing run). R3: gate 7's browser correctness runs on the CI-only lavapipe renderer (lib/browser-renderer.ts): the file groups (every timing group of their native sources skipped by RS_SKIP_TIMING_GROUPS) and the live correctness groups g7-5 and g7-55 (refuse.groups keeps only live g7-1 local: GSW live-resync shots disagree across runners, see its reason. Live g7-2 became remote-capable in GRT5, df52bcff). Every -timing run (g7-6, g7-lc, g7-r, g7-k) is refused by phase, g7x by id, device legs by match; the native receiver has no live correctness run (run-gate7.sh runs g7-r only there).
